title: Capture from anywhere: Shortcuts, widget, Action Button
acceptance: A Shortcuts action saves a URL to the library, usable from the Action Button and automations
A home-screen widget saves whatever is on the clipboard, or opens straight to save
Both paths go through the same inbox the share extension uses; no second save path exists
Saving from any path confirms visibly and fast
notes: Owner says capture is awkward. The share sheet is currently the only path and it is the slow one. Critically: one inbox, one pipeline — a second save path is how archives get inconsistent.
